import json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

source=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
target=Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")
req_id="sonary-daw-typecheck-stage-isolation-20261008-143"

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(source/"src")

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=source,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env)

cancel=run([
    "python3","-m","do_again.cli",
    "cancel",req_id,str(target),
    "--reason","expired orphaned request with no receipt, claim, executor, or active ledger evidence"
])

print("=== cancel stdout ===")
print(cancel.stdout)
print("=== cancel stderr ===")
print(cancel.stderr)
print("cancel_rc="+str(cancel.returncode))
if cancel.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit("supported cancellation refused; no further mutation attempted")

dry=run(["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(target)])

print("=== post-cancel upgrade preflight stdout ===")
print(dry.stdout)
print("=== post-cancel upgrade preflight stderr ===")
print(dry.stderr)
print("preflight_rc="+str(dry.returncode))

try:
    parsed=json.loads(dry.stdout)
except Exception as exc:
    raise SystemExit(f"could not parse preflight JSON: {exc}")

blockers=((parsed.get("preflight") or {}).get("blockers") or [])
print(json.dumps({
  "cancelled_request":req_id,
  "post_cancel_blockers":blockers,
  "safe":(parsed.get("preflight") or {}).get("safe"),
  "deferred":parsed.get("deferred"),
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

if any(b.get("kind")=="pending_requests" and req_id in (b.get("request_ids") or []) for b in blockers):
    raise SystemExit("cancelled orphan still blocks rollout")

print("SONARY_ORPHAN_CANCEL_AND_PREFLIGHT_OK")
